pack: PFTL fee-market and spam-resistance evidence pack

environment.network: public endpoints only; no credentials, sessions, accounts, or signing

live_endpoints: https://docs.postfiat.org (Notion JavaScript shell; no retrievable content)
verdict: 12 findings: 2 HIGH, 5 MEDIUM, 4 LOW, 1 INFO. The fee market is at its floor on an idle testnet; the anti-spam machinery is implemented in pinned code but has never been exercised live, and the binding queue-fill cost is the 2,000 PFT account-reserve lockup, not transaction fees.
notes: Assessment only: no transactions sent, no flood traffic, no mainnet touched, no funds spent, nothing signed.
Bounded observation only: at most ~40 read-only RPC calls in probe_all.sh plus 60 in the 20-sample fee time series.
Live values were re-probed for this pack; no numbers were copied from earlier packs.
